description: Learn more about the trails at https://www.southstartrails.com/
directions:
The trailhead is located at the south end of 38th Avenue, off the Gold Creek Road in Cranbrook. The parkin area is within the first 100m of the Joseph Creek FSR.
Do not park along both sides of 38th avenue, as it restricts access to emergency services.
title: South Star Snowshoe
